title: GDP — third estimate, Q3 2026 (with Industries, Corporate Profits, State GDP and State Personal Income)
source: BEA: bea.gov/news/schedule, fetched direct 2026-09-05 by this event's own never-assessed research lane, whose December 2026 block reads verbatim "December 23, 8:30 AM, News, GDP (Third Estimate), Industries, Corporate Profits, State GDP, and State Personal Income, 3rd Quarter 2026". The same fetch independently reproduces both predecessor vintages of the same quarter — "October 29, 8:30 AM … GDP (Advance Estimate), 3rd Quarter 2026" and "November 25, 8:30 AM … GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits, 3rd Quarter 2026" — so the full three-vintage Q3 sequence reads off one primary. Promoted `estimate` → `confirmed` in this pass: the prior `EST:` note reserved the confirming re-read for "whichever lane owns this event's own never-assessed research", and that condition is now met. Note the payload differs from the Q2 analogue (gdp-q2-2026-third-2026-09-30): this line carries no "State PCE, 2025" component
notes: The final Q3 vintage, and it lands FOURTEEN DAYS AFTER the 12-08/09 FOMC — so it is the only Q3 real-side reading published after the year's final SEP, the first release that can show the number the last dot plot was set on subsequently moved. It is also the only release carrying Q3 GDP by industry, the REVISED corporate-profits estimate (the preliminary lands 11-25) and the state accounts. Discovered during the gdp-q3-2026-second-2026-11-25 initial research (2026-09-05); researched in its own right 2026-09-05 — docs/research/events/gdp-q3-2026-third-2026-12-23.md. CORRECTION TO THIS ENTRY'S EARLIER NOTE, on BEA primaries fetched 2026-09-05: the claim that "BEA deletes rather than delays a GDP vintage in a lapse", and therefore that this print inherits the existence risk the 10-29 advance estimate shed, is REFUTED. BEA's schedule-update post of 2025-11-24 cancelled the ADVANCE vintage outright ("Gross Domestic Product, 3rd Quarter 2025 (Advance Estimate) is cancelled"), while its 2025-12-10 post rescheduled the third-estimate payload INTACT — "Jan. 22: Updated estimate (replaces the typical third estimate)", carrying "GDP by Industry, and Corporate Profits (Revised)", with state GDP and personal income on Jan. 23. BEA deletes the vintage a later vintage can absorb; a terminal vintage has no successor, so it moves rather than dies. H.R. 6500 still runs only to 2026-12-11 (cr-expiry-2026-12-11), twelve days before this date, so the funding exposure is real — but it is a MOVED DATE, not a hole in the record. Earliest primary read on whether it moves: BEA's 12-18 U.S. International Transactions release (intl-transactions-q3-2026-12-18), the first BEA publication inside a hypothetical lapse window. Impact `medium` is now measured rather than inherited: BEA's own Comparisons of Revisions to Real GDP (updated Nov 2025, 1999–2024) puts second→third revisions at mean 0.0pp, 0.3pp without regard to sign, sd 0.4 — the smallest and only unbiased step it publishes. Shares its 08:30 ET tick with November PCE (pce-2026-12-23) and advance durable goods (durable-goods-2026-12-23), on the last full session before the 12-24 1:00pm ET close and the 12-25 holiday (NYSE primary, fetched 2026-09-05).
